goal: Based on REFERENCE_0, change the Tesla Cybertruck's body color from stainless steel to matte black, keeping the exhibition space and any characters (if present) unchanged.

reference_0.assumed_input: Assumed original image: A Tesla Cybertruck parked at a 3/4 angle from the side front, with the body in original brushed stainless steel silver, featuring typical triangular facets and black plastic wheel arch trims, parked in an open space showroom with soft light reflections on the ground, main light coming from the upper left front, with tires and rims, window glass, and side mirrors included in the frame

edit.target: Tesla Cybertruck Enclosed Body Shell Triangular Surface (Including Visible Parts of Doors and Rear Bed Folding Cover), Excluding Tire Rubber, Excluding Transparent Glass and Inside Structure of Tail Lights
edit.replace_with: Frosted black metallic paint surface with the same geometry and seam lines: mainly diffuse reflection, narrow and clean highlights at the corners, fine texture without orange peel, no characteristics of a modified model
edit.retain_unchanged: Exhibition hall floor, background wall and signage, any characters or booths in the picture foreground and edges, rim shapes, rain shields on the upper edge of side windows, and grooves for door handles
edit.lighting: Recalculate the highlight position and matte texture based on the main light direction of the original image on the black paint, generating a slightly deeper and softer projection outline on the ground consistent with the black car body

do_not: Change the vehicle's length wheelbase or the number of triangular folds.
Change the car window to an opaque material
must: Tesla T and rear badge area, if visible in the original image, only changes with the paint surface brightness without adding or removing text
